messages.subject: Multiple rhcollects
parts:
I am trying to see if there are similar elements populated in the key and the values. And hence would like to know if I can send out multiple rhcollect function calls per key, value pair read in. 

So this is what I am working with. I have a key and this key could potentially be featured in the value as well (in another key, value pair) . I want to see if a certain key is  part of a value in another key, value pair. So I am trying to rhcollect all the keys and also the value for every key, value pair. 

pseudo code 

for each key, value pair { 
                rhcollect( key, key flag) 
                rhcollect(value, value flag)
                                     }

Mind you, the keys and values are similar data. So I want to make a list of keys and a list of values. And then compare these two values to see if there are any common elements between them. For which I am trying to call rhcollect twice. With my initial runs this does not seem to occur.  Could anyone be kind enough to throw some light on this? Is it that rhcollect can be called only once per key, value pair? Or is there a way I could work around this? 

Thanks in advance
Ashrith

t2r <- list()
t2r$map <- expression({
lapply(seq_along(map.values),function(r){
if(grepl("com",map.keys[[r]]['name'],ignore.case=T,useBytes=T)==T){
key <- map.keys[[r]][[1]]
record <- map.keys[[r]][[4]]
comip <- gsub("(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)(.*)","\\4.\\3.\\2.\\1",grep("(\\d+\\.){4}",record,value=T))
if(!length(comip) == F && !length(key) == F){if(comip != key){
rhcollect(comip, 1) ## 1 is the flag set when the IP address is seen in the value.
rhcollect(key,2)}}} ## 2 is the flag set when the IP address is seen in the key.
})
})

t2r$reduce <- expression(
  pre = {
finalvec <- vector()
},
  reduce = { tempvec <- unlist(reduce.values)
},
  post = { append(finalvec,tempvec) 
rhcollect(reduce.key,finalvec)}
)
